signin-lands-on-dashboard.statement: A BD Executive who signs in with a valid username and password lands on their Home dashboard, greeted by first name, with BD Executive shown as their role.
signin-lands-on-dashboard.subject: sign-in

signin-needs-both-fields.statement: On the sign-in page, the Sign in button stays disabled until both a username and a password are entered.
signin-needs-both-fields.subject: sign-in

signin-username-forgiving.statement: Usernames are matched without regard to letter case or surrounding spaces, so " Kavya.Iyer " signs in as kavya.iyer.
signin-username-forgiving.subject: sign-in

signin-wrong-password-rejected.statement: Signing in with a wrong password keeps the person on the sign-in page and shows an error; they are not signed in.
signin-wrong-password-rejected.subject: sign-in
